evidence: Route 1, per-item descriptive statistics across samples, verifying item_text <-> item. The deposit carries no labels of any kind (88 bare headers, zero CJK, no variable/value labels) and neither Ren et al. nor the deposit prints item wording, so the tie between the code SCPVk and item k of the CPPRG form is the numeric suffix alone and had to be checked. Live per-item means (N=299 Chinese parents), rescaled -1 to the form's 0-4 metric, against Corrigan (2003) Fast Track technical report section VI item means: SCPV1 1.74/1.96, SCPV2 1.84/1.89, SCPV3 1.85/2.25, SCPV4 2.02/2.27, SCPV5 1.79/2.30, SCPV6 2.13/2.66, SCPV7 2.40/2.92, SCPV8 1.93/2.09, SCPV9 2.62/2.95, SCPV10 2.82/3.27, SCPV11 2.36/2.64, SCPV12 2.21/2.42. Spearman 0.888 vs the normative sample and 0.930 vs the control sample, Pearson 0.937; permutation p = 0.00015 over 20,000 random relabelings of the 12 codes. Corroboration from Ren et al.'s own reported alphas: the CPPRG partition (EMO 1,2,3,5,6,8 / PRO 4,7,9,10,11,12) gives 0.742 and 0.870 against reported 0.78 and 0.88 (total 0.887 vs 0.90), ranking 39th of 924 possible 6/6 splits -- consistent, not decisive. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: it does not distinguish every item from every other. 30 of the 66 single swaps still clear Spearman 0.80 and three (SCPV1<->SCPV2, SCPV6<->SCPV11, SCPV6<->SCPV12) raise it to 0.902, so no individual near-tied pair is pinned; the alpha route pins subscale membership at best and never order within a subscale; and nothing here tests option_text <-> resp beyond the two endpoint anchors Ren et al. print in prose. Hence PARTIAL.

Route 3: Ren et al. 2019 Table 5 reports r = 0.706 between the SCPV Emotion-Regulation and Prosocial/Communication subscale scores in this very sample; scoring the live table under the Fast Track canonical membership (EmoReg = SCPV1,2,3,5,6,8) gives r = 0.7017, a difference of 0.0043, and across all 924 six/six splits (r range 0.623-0.874) the canonical split ranks 7.5th closest to 0.706. Route 1 cross-sample: Corrigan (2003) Fast Track Year-3 normative per-item means (0-4 metric, +1 to match) 1.96,1.89,2.25,2.27,2.30,2.66,2.92,2.09,2.95,3.27,2.64,2.42 vs live 2.74,2.84,2.85,3.02,2.79,3.13,3.40,2.93,3.62,3.82,3.36,3.21 -> Pearson 0.937, Spearman 0.888; 58 of 66 single transpositions of item_text are strictly worse. NOT ESTABLISHED: 8 transpositions (1<->2, 2<->5, 3<->5, 3<->8, 4<->5, 5<->8, 6<->11, 6<->12) fit as well or better on the mean profile, and route 3 does not exclude 6<->12 either (that swap gives 0.7061, marginally nearer 0.706 than the canonical 0.7017). So subscale membership and the overall difficulty ordering are pinned; the order within the Emotional-Regulation block is not, which is why this is PARTIAL rather than VERIFIED.
